lines.text: The LORD gives Jeremiah a cup of the wine of wrath to make all the nations drink.
Jeremiah makes the nations drink, starting with Jerusalem and the cities of Judah.
If a nation refuses the cup, it must drink anyway, and disaster begins with the city of Nineveh.
The LORD will sing from on high, and those He slays will not be mourned or buried.
The shepherds wail because the LORD is destroying their pasture, and the land is desolate by the sword of the oppressor.
